title: Complete source-bound four-provider finite admission for PR4088
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

This completes the retained PR4088 four-provider construction's missing finite ordinary/outer admission through the inherited PR4085 engine. The successor binds all four native providers and both orientations, carries the literal selector through each actual call, and recomputes the complete idle invoice from the selected helper widths. It preserves the inherited acceptance predicates and semantic failure controls.

Both the development replay and a fresh default replay from an isolated committed export returned `PASS_REPLICA_ORDER_FILL_DERIVATIVE_COMPLETE_RELEASE` and `PASS_RELEASE`. The latter executed fresh source reconstruction and both FOUR native replays, then all 23 ordinary stages and the complete outer release. Its actual strict controls were 201 assembly, 43 controller, 12 bit, 8 independent owner and 6 geometry; the outer ledger checked 63 strict inequalities and 17 rejecting controls. The seven full-driver stages totalled 2,021.013 seconds on the recorded environment.

The distinct contribution is the source-bound admission integration and its evidence, not another moment root or the already known PR4165 idle finding. Selected kappa remains **0.001672660197076918** (#1094). No new supplier architecture, selected-frontier promotion, all-size multiplication theorem or formal proof is claimed.

Only `research/mixed-provider-admission/` is added. Frozen predecessors, `upstream/`, selected certificates and shared code are unchanged.

## Task and overlap

Task: `supplier-boundary-audit`, priority revision 7. Scope is **refined** to the concrete PR4165 handoff for PR4088's ordinary/outer caller.

Exact canonical base: `12fa8c5c844be21bfefb38a19503fbd867a11244`.

Consumed predecessor heads, retained at that canonical base:

- PR4088: `72d7efc181edb21806a878f174847c96dd410ab0`.
- PR4165: `430072ee4130b58c1dd952cb37fd81759675a118`.
- PR4085: `c5854c77620723aae6914c32122870519a6f820d`.
- PR4076: `9744f9df268590295a9872b1952c695a678192b9`.
- PR3945: `91f81d131252db704f945891da1ea54e29d46b8b`.

`SOURCES.json` binds all 192 consumed live files to canonical-base Git objects and SHA256. The exact reconstructed predecessor has 676 files; its manifest is `4116ef61479e509811b60b5fd4e84db8811dae079092f2f83bdcc2c80052c0da` and its admission driver is `e69184d235d8790a3c520977dd44dcfb73a99d56989825485f922ff61059c8b1`. The adapter logs every modification and produces a 680-file successor source tree.

The paginated overlap refresh at 2026-10-20 08:54 UTC covered 295 open/draft PRs and 2,695 Discussion records without warnings; the 50 most recently updated PRs were also inspected for successors. [PR4170](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4170) covers pooled-ceiling transfer; [PR4171](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4171) checks PR4100's finite moment/paid-power arithmetic; [PR4169](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4169) audits a CRT repair implication. The new [Discussion4173](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4173) claim covers CRT reservoir placement; PR4172 concerns QQ16 comparison. None supplies this four-provider ordinary/outer replay. Search is advisory, not a novelty certificate. Coordination was local-only.

This does not repeat yssite's merged PR959, PR1558, PR2377, or PR2469's Windows follow-up.

## Validation

The package README, `COVERAGE.md` and `EVIDENCE.md` give the claim-to-caller map and actual evidence. `EVIDENCE.json` records checked execution receipts and `REPLAY.log` contains actual stdout excerpts with paths normalized. The isolated replay used implementation commit `b1eb3cec856e1f56a4ce70c583bce738223be6b2`; all 208 exported files remained unchanged, and all nine tested Python sources remain byte-identical in the final contribution. Subsequent changes finalize documentation, metadata and execution receipts. Reproduce the bounded registered regression:

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/mixed-provider-admission
```

Expected: `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`, with source authentication, 14 semantic unit tests, optimized controls, all 1,321,920 owner rows and a separate event/span implementation. The latter imports neither the predecessor owner walker nor the new admission binder.

Run the complete inherited replay separately in a new directory outside the checkout:

```sh
python3 -B research/mixed-provider-admission/replay.py --work /tmp/mixed-admission-fresh
python3 -B research/mixed-provider-admission/challenge.py --work /tmp/mixed-admission-fresh
python3 -O -B research/mixed-provider-admission/challenge.py --work /tmp/mixed-admission-fresh
```

Expected full status: `PASS_REPLICA_ORDER_FILL_DERIVATIVE_COMPLETE_RELEASE`. The two challenge commands each check 18 positive/negative cases. The full driver deliberately rejects optimized Python because inherited assertions remain mandatory.

Full runtime: CPython 3.12, NumPy 2.3.5, SciPy 1.17.0, SymPy 1.14.0, mpmath 1.3.0; tested interpreter 3.12.14 on Linux. The driver checks the versions and installs nothing. Registered regression uses only the standard library.

Actual invariants include:

- Four providers, 3,240 calls, 408 helpers/call; call counts `(1040, 1110, 528, 562)` for `(gauge44, extra, gauge44-four, extra-four)`.
- THREE/FOUR helper 601 widths 8/7; changing call zero to THREE breaks the real later prefix at owner row 29,389.
- Idle `{3:22783, 5:1625, 48:138492}` and complete profile `{1:8060060, 2:2310120, 3:751813, 4:327210, 5:66425, 8:25920, 48:138492}`, mass 23,431,680.
- Physical inventory 323,069; actual prefix `95+37+18+1323+1+4=1478`, charged at 2048; physical row coefficient 19,549 below 20,161.
- Fresh FOUR native execution through all five stages; authenticated unchanged THREE/parent evidence is explicitly labeled reuse. Fixed scientific commitments cover eleven native products/provider and preserve JSON/gzip transport equivalence.

Controls reject wrong/omitted providers, wrong program or orientation, averaged widths, stale idle, capacity/window/prefix errors, source changes, skipped phase stages, and a changed phase even after all recipe references are coherently rebound. Separate AI review found two draft authentication gaps; both were corrected and independently challenged before publication. The initial dispatch table-order failure and its coverage-preserving correction are documented.

No repository-wide historical suite, selected-frontier cold replay, Windows execution, dense native backend, Lean proof or hosted CI is claimed. Full replay authenticates retained ancestry receipts; it is not a cold rebuild of every historical parent. Archive integrity and local execution are not independent human review.

The optional full-history `--check-source-history` preflight was not executed in this shallow workspace. All declared source pins resolve at the canonical base, the implementation commit's direct parent. Metadata, Git-blob pins, committed bytes and the Git-free export were checked separately.

The final-tree registered package check passed with outcome `completed`. A final canonical fetch at 2026-10-20 09:06 UTC still returned the exact base above.

Publication head: `15a4153e734a8d1d485c6d3bea9b1a8201328a4c`. The committed-byte preflight passes all 210 package/input files, and the remote head was read back after pushing. The final diff adds only 18 files in the new package.

Prepared for **yssite with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance** in research, implementation, documentation and two separate AI checking contexts. Those contexts are not independent human review or formal verification. New work is Apache-2.0; predecessor licenses, attribution and notices are preserved.

## Open next questions

1. Independently execute and scientifically review this exact admission before any frontier-selection decision. The README provides the first command and the coverage map; maintainer review remains separate from archival source retention.
2. Pin one actual caller-bound all-size implication using the live PR4100/PR4169/Discussion4173 handoffs and current `uniform-transfer-audit` card. Uniform generation/lifting, precision/conditioning, fixed-tape realization and analytic transfer are not discharged by finite supplier admission. Avoid duplicating the live CRT reservoir claim. A general argument is needed; another evaluation of this unchanged root is not the next step.
